localChanges: Importing SP257.PIC and TER257.PIC used to lock the page up for well over two minutes. It now finishes in about a quarter of a second, and the page stays responsive while it does (#50).

The work was one loop: knocking the transparent colour out of each sprite read the canvas a single pixel at a time, and swept the whole 320x200 source image rather than the sprite sitting in the corner of it — eighteen million reads to handle sixty-nine thousand pixels. The extracted sprites are unchanged, right down to the pixel. Writing them to the browser's database is one transaction now rather than one per sprite, and the dialog no longer warns you to go and make a cup of tea.
